Dinesh Remedies Limited.acquirer: Dixit Rashmikant Patel, Bharat Ratilal Patel and Bhailalbhai Patel
Dinesh Remedies Limited.note: Dixit Rashmikant Patel, Bharat Ratilal Patel, and Bhailalbhai Patel completed the acquisition of a 55.52% stake in Dinesh Remedies Ltd. from Shri Dinesh Mills Limited in September 2025, which later rebranded as Gelikaps Lifesciences Ltd.

Guang De Li Capsules Co., Ltd..note: The company operates as a subsidiary of the De Li Group.

MagnaKasr Pharma Solutions.note: MagnaKasr Pharma Solutions operates in Turkey as a capsule manufacturer with no verifiable record of an acquisition.

Qingdao Yiqing Biotechnology Co., Ltd..note: Baotou Dongbao Bio-Tech Co.,Ltd acquired an initial 60% stake in 2021 and completed the acquisition of the remaining 40% stake in October 2024.

Eva Grow Medicaps Pvt. Ltd..note: The company operates independently and was formerly known as Eva Grow Plastics Private Limited before renaming in 2021.

Nashmir Capsule Sdn. Bhd..note: The company continues to operate independently as a private halal-focused capsule manufacturer in Malaysia.

Tokai Capsule Co., Ltd..note: Ono Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. sold its entire equity stake in Tokai Capsule Co., Ltd. during the fiscal year ended March 31, 2017.

Zhejiang Yueshan Capsule Co., Ltd..note: The company operates independently as an empty capsule manufacturer in China under the YS brand.
